queries: WITH line_totals AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) AS total_cost, COUNT(*) AS expense_count FROM expense WHERE link_to_budget IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_budget), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS avg_total FROM line_totals) SELECT AVG(lt.total_cost) AS average_total, SUM(lt.expense_count) AS total_expenses, AVG(lt.total_cost - oa.avg_total) AS average_excess FROM line_totals AS lt CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa WHERE lt.total_cost > oa.avg_total;

WITH line_totals AS (SELECT link_to_budget, COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) AS total_cost, COUNT(*) AS expense_count FROM expense GROUP BY link_to_budget), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS avg_total FROM line_totals) SELECT AVG(l.total_cost) AS avg_qualifying_total, COALESCE(SUM(l.expense_count), 0) AS total_expenses, AVG(l.total_cost - o.avg_total) AS avg_excess FROM line_totals AS l CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE l.total_cost > o.avg_total;

WITH line_totals AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) AS total_cost, COUNT(*) AS expense_count FROM expense WHERE link_to_budget IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_budget), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS average_total FROM line_totals) SELECT AVG(l.total_cost) AS average_qualifying_total, COALESCE(SUM(l.expense_count), 0) AS total_expenses, AVG(l.total_cost - b.average_total) AS average_excess FROM line_totals AS l CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE l.total_cost > b.average_total;
